mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE group_tree AS ( SELECT id, group_name, 0 AS depth FROM fcc_agent_group WHERE id = #{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.group_name, tree.depth + 1 FROM fcc_agent_group child JOIN group_tree tree ON child.parent_id = tree.id WHERE child.deleted_at IS NULL AND child.status = 'ENABLED' )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.agent_id) FROM group_tree tree JOIN fcc_agent_group_member member ON member.group_id = tree.id AND member.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN fcc_agent agent ON agent.id = member.agent_id AND agent.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (agent.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR agent.work_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR agent.phone_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
